definitions.gloss: sentence pattern; grammatical pattern; sentence structure
definitions.explanation: A standard pattern or template for constructing sentences in a language. A key concept in Japanese language education.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{文型|ぶんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: To learn a new sentence pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各課|かくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文型|ぶんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This textbook introduces three sentence patterns in each lesson.

examples.japanese: {文型|ぶんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's practice making your own sentences using the sentence patterns.

notes:
A term learners of Japanese encounter constantly in textbooks and classrooms. Japanese language education is heavily structured around {文型|ぶんけい}, with each lesson typically introducing one or more patterns (e.g., ～たこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧, ～⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧). Composed of ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (sentence) + {型|けい} (pattern/form).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文型|ぶんけい}⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: sentence pattern practice/drills
- {基本文型|きほんぶんけい}: basic sentence pattern
- {文型|ぶんけい}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: list of sentence patterns
- {文型|ぶんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧: to introduce a sentence pattern (teaching)
- {文型|ぶんけい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: sentence pattern dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧: grammar — the broader system of rules; {文型|ぶんけい} refers to specific patterns within grammar
- ⟦{構文|こうぶん}→構文：26934_koubun⟧: syntax; sentence structure — more technical/linguistic; {文型|ぶんけい} is more pedagogical
- ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: expression — a particular way of saying something, not necessarily a structural pattern
